# Vendored libraries

- `mediabunny.min.mjs`: [Mediabunny](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny)
  1.66.0 (`dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` from the npm package), used by
  `js/remux.js` to repackage MKV files into MP4 in the browser. Licensed under
  the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (`mediabunny.LICENSE.txt`); unmodified.
  Loaded only when an MKV is played.
